title: Israeli Cabinet Unanimously Recognizes Armenian Genocide, Turkey Rejects Move as 'Politically Motivated'
detail: On June 28, 2026, the Israeli cabinet unanimously voted to formally recognize the 1915–1923 killings of Armenians under the Ottoman Empire as genocide, following a resolution from Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar, who called it a 'moral and historical duty' and said 'it's never too late to do the right thing.' The measure still requires Knesset ratification. Turkey's Foreign Ministry rejected the move as a politically motivated attempt to distract from Israel's conduct in Gaza, stating that a government 'being tried at the International Court of Justice for genocide against the people of Gaza' had no standing to lecture Türkiye on history. The move comes amid a sharp deterioration in Turkey-Israel relations since the Gaza war began in October 2023.

media.caption: Israel's cabinet votes to recognize the Armenian genocide amid frosty ties with Turkey — June 28, 2026
